title: IKyber ibikhona eVivaTech
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
html:
IKyber eVivaTech 2026: Izinsuku ezine zokubonisa ubuchwepheshe, ukuvela kwabezindaba nezingxoxo ezinohlonze

IVivaTech 2026 isiphothuliwe, kodwa ngeke siyikhohlwe masinyane. Izinsuku ezine simatasatasa emcimbini wezobuchwepheshe omkhulu kunayo yonke eYurophu, ithimba lethu leKyber belibonisa indlela ingqalasizinda yethu esebenza ngayo ngesikhathi sangempela. Besihlangene nonjiniyela, abasunguli bamabhizinisi, abatshalizimali nabaqambi abavela emhlabeni wonke.

Nakhu okwenzekile, abantu esixoxe nabo nokuthi kungani lo mcimbi ububaluleke kangaka kithi.

Kungani siye eVivaTech 2026?

EVivaTech yilapho kubanjwa khona izingxoxo ezibalulekile. Amarobhothi, izindiza ezingenamshayeli, i-XR, izinhlelo ezizenzela imisebenzi ngobuhlakani bokwenziwa, ingqalasizinda elawulwa ngamazwe ayo nezinhlelo ezisebenza ngesikhathi sangempela akusezona izihloko zabantu abambalwa. Yikho lokhu okubumba ikusasa lobuchwepheshe, futhi iVivaTech ikuveze ngokucace kunanini ngaphambili njengoba ibigubha iminyaka eyishumi yasungulwa.

Bekungokwemvelo ukuba iKyber ibe khona. Sakha ingqalasizinda esebenza ngesikhathi sangempela, ecishe ingabi nakubambezeleka, yale nkathi lapho ubuhlakani bokwenziwa sebusebenza emishinini yangempela. Ngayo, amarobhothi, izindiza ezingenamshayeli, izinhlelo ze-XR nemishini ezisebenzelayo kungalawulwa ukude, kuphendule cishe ngaso leso sikhathi. Yilapho kanye eVivaTech lapho abadinga lobu buchwepheshe behlangana khona ukuze babone ukuthi yini elandelayo.

Besisesitendini sabangane bethu esisebenzisana nabo bakwaScaleway, eHholo 7.3, eSitendini 3F10. Isonto lonke besibonisa izivakashi, zilandelana, ukuthi iKyber isebenza kanjani.

UJean-Baptiste Kempf eVivaTech: esiteji, kumabonakude nasemaphephandabeni

Esiteji ne-Inria

UJean-Baptiste Kempf, umsunguli weKyber nongomunye wabaholi ekuthuthukisweni kweVLC, wethule inkulumo eVivaTech enesihloko esithi “Ukusuka ekubhaleni ikhodi kuya ekunikezeni imiyalo”. Le nkulumo ibihlelwe ngokubambisana ne-Inria, isikhungo sikazwelonke saseFrance socwaningo lwesayensi yedijithali nobuchwepheshe.

Inkulumo ibigxile emibuzweni emibili ephuthuma kakhulu embonini yezobuchwepheshe namuhla:

Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa bushintshani emaqenjini onjiniyela? Njengoba amamodeli amakhulu olimi esekwazi ukubhala ikhodi esezingeni lokusetshenziswa emsebenzini wangempela, liyashintsha kakhulu iqhaza labathuthukisi besofthiwe. Izinhlangano zisaqasha onjiniyela ngendlela ebezibaqasha ngayo? Zisabaqasha nokubaqasha?

Kuzokwenzekani ngamathuluzi nangengqalasizinda esakhele phezu kwayo konke? Izinkundla zokugcina nokuthuthukisa ikhodi, izinqubo zokwakha nokukhipha isofthiwe nengqalasizinda yamasevisi efu: konke kucatshangwa kabusha njengoba indlela esakha ngayo isofthiwe ishintsha kusukela ezisekelweni zayo.

Lena akuyona imibuzo yokuqagela nje. Kumsunguli onjengoJean-Baptiste, osechithe amashumi eminyaka akha ingqalasizinda ebalulekile enekhodi evulelekile, yimibuzo ethinta ngqo umsebenzi wakhe.

BFM Business, Tech & Co

NgoMsombuluko, zingama-22 kuNhlangulana, uJean-Baptiste Kempf ube yisivakashi sikaFrançois Sorel ohlelweni lwansuku zonke iTech & Co kuBFM Business. Bekukhona noThomas Serval (i-CEO yakwaBaracoda), uJean Schmitt (umongameli weJolt Capital) noHugo Borensztein (omunye wabasunguli be-Omi nongumongameli wayo).

Babuyekeze iVivaTech yeshumi: baxoxa ngokuvela kukaJeff Bezos embukisweni, obekusematheni, ngokusunguliwe phakathi kokubukisiwe okuhlabe umxhwele ngamunye wabo nangekusasa lalo mcimbi obalulekile kwezobuchwepheshe eYurophu.

Phinda ubuke kuBFM Business

BSMART 4Change

UJean-Baptiste Kempf uphinde wavela kuBSMART 4Change, okwenze iKyber yavela nakakhulu kwabezindaba phakathi nesonto lomcimbi.

Phinda ubuke ingxoxo

TechCrunch

Indaba yeKyber idonse amehlo eTechCrunch, eshicilele udaba ngoJean-Baptiste Kempf nobuchwepheshe abakhayo. Udaba lulandela umsebenzi wakhe kusukela kuVLC, isidlali samavidiyo samahhala esidume kunazo zonke emhlabeni, kuze kufike engqalasizindeni esebenza ngesikhathi sangempela yamarobhothi nezinhlelo zobuhlakani bokwenziwa ezisebenza emishinini yangempela.

Funda udaba lweTechCrunch: “Wenze isidlali sakho samavidiyo samahhala sasebenza ngokushelela. Manje wenza okufanayo ngamarobhothi.”

Izinsuku ezine zemibukiso nezingxoxo zebhizinisi

Ngale kokuvela kwabezindaba, okugqame kakhulu kuleli sonto yizingxoxo esibe nazo khona embukisweni.

Kuzo zonke izinsuku ezine besilokhu sibonisa indlela ubuchwepheshe beKyber obusebenza ngayo ngesikhathi sangempela, nezivakashi bezikwazi ukuzizamela bona. Ividiyo, umsindo, idatha yezinzwa nemiyalo yokulawula konke kusingathwa ngokubambezeleka okungaphansi kuka-10 ms, kungaba semafwini, ezinhlelweni ezixubile noma emaphethelweni enethiwekhi.

Besixoxa nabo bonke: labo esingase sibambisane nabo bebehlola ukuthi singabuhlanganisa kanjani ubuchwepheshe bethu nobabo; amakhasimende efuna ukwazi ukuthi iKyber ingangena kanjani ezinhlelweni zawo; abasunguli becobelelana ngolwazi; onjiniyela bebuza imibuzo enzima ngobuchwepheshe. Ubuningi balezi zingxoxo nokwehluka kwazo yikho okwenza iVivaTech yehluke kweminye imicimbi.

Umcimbi ufike nangesikhathi esibalulekile kithi. IKyber isanda kumemezela ukuthi iqoqe amaRandi? Cha, izigidi ezi-5 zamadola aseMelika emzuliswaneni woxhaso lokuqala, iLightspeed ihola, kwalandela iKima ne-OVNI Capital. Lesi simemezelo sidonse amehlo alabo kanye ebesifisa ukuhlangana nabo embukisweni.

Siyabonga

Sibonga ngokusuka enhliziyweni kubo bonke abadlule esitendini bezoxoxa, bezozizamela ubuchwepheshe bethu noma bezobuza nje. Sibonga ngokukhethekile abakwaScaleway ngokwamukela ithimba leKyber esitendini sabo zonke izinsuku ezine. Kwenza umehluko ukuba nabalingani abahle.

Sobonana eVivaTech 2027

IVivaTech yeshumi ibe nomfutho, yahlanganisa abantu bamazwe amaningi, kwenziwa nebhizinisi langempela. Size ukuzobonisa esikwakhayo, sihlangane nabantu ababumba imboni, siveze nokuthi ubuchwepheshe obusezingeni eliphezulu obuthuthukiswa eFrance busadlondlobala.

Sikufezile ebesikuzele.

Sizobuya. Sobonana ngonyaka ozayo 💎

Ufuna ukwazi kabanzi ngeKyber? Vakashela ku-kyber.tech noma usibhalele ku-contact@kyber.tech.

Izinkampani okukhulunywe ngazo kulesi sihloko

Scaleway: Umhlinzeki waseFrance wamasevisi efu ohlinzeka ngengqalasizinda ezimele futhi esimeme, okuhlanganisa ukucutshungulwa nokugcinwa kwedatha kanye namasevisi awaphathela amakhasimende.

Inria: Isikhungo sikazwelonke saseFrance socwaningo lwesayensi yedijithali nobuchwepheshe, esigxile ezibalweni, kwisayensi yamakhompyutha nasekusetshenzisweni kwazo.

BFM Business: Isiteshi sikamabonakude saseFrance esisakaza ubusuku nemini, zonke izinsuku, sigxile ezindabeni zomnotho, ezezimali nezobuchwepheshe.

BSMART: Isiteshi sikamabonakude saseFrance esigxile kwezamabhizinisi nasekusunguleni okusha. Sibika ngokusungulwa kwamabhizinisi, ngobuchwepheshe nangoguquko olusimeme.

TechCrunch: Inkundla yezindaba ehamba phambili emhlabeni ebika ngamabhizinisi asafufusa, ngobuchwepheshe nangokutshalwa kwemali emabhizinisini asafufusa.

Baracoda: Inkampani yobuchwepheshe bezempilo nobamadivayisi axhumeke ku-inthanethi. Yakha amadivayisi axhunyiwe nezixazululo ezihlakaniphile zezindawo zokusebenza nezomkhakha wezempilo.

Jolt Capital: Isikhwama saseYurophu esitshala imali ukuze sikhulise izinkampani ezakha ubuchwepheshe obuseqophelweni eliphezulu nalezo ezihlinzeka amanye amabhizinisi ngobuchwepheshe.

Omi: Inkundla yamadivayisi agqokwayo asebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa ukusiza umsebenzisi akhumbule okwenzekayo ngesikhathi sangempela, enze umsebenzi omningi futhi athole usizo oluqondene naye.

Lightspeed: Inkampani yomhlaba wonke etshala imali emabhizinisini asafufusa, kusukela kwesanda kuqala kuya kwakhulayo, emikhakheni yabathengi, yamabhizinisi neyobuchwepheshe obuseqophelweni eliphezulu.

Kima Ventures: Isikhwama esizinze eParis esitshala imali emabhizinisini asanda kuqala, nesingesinye sezikhwama ezikhuthele kakhulu eYurophu ekuxhaseni amabhizinisi kulesi sigaba.

OVNI Capital: Isikhwama saseFrance esitshala imali emabhizinisini ezobuchwepheshe asafufusa anesibindi sokubumba kabusha imikhakha yawo.
